name: phil/organizations-bundle
description: Organizations in a Symfony application: members, roles, teams, units in a tree with inherited roles, invitations, and acting on behalf with the author recorded.

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the tables to the schema the ORM generates, for doctrine:migrations:diff
suggest.phil/access-bundle: To publish memberships and roles as relations and tuples, partitioned by tenant
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: For the exporter and eraser of a member's personal data
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes the administration pages of the units draw — Badge, Button, Input, NativeSelect, Table, Tree —, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/console: For phil:organizations:list, show, check-owners and purge-invitations
suggest.symfony/security-core: For the voter of the organization permissions and roles
suggest.symfony/security-csrf: With Twig, routing and Symfony Security, for the administration pages of the units
suggest.twig/twig: With the CSRF protection, routing and Symfony Security, for the administration pages of the units
